dogecoin.text: Analysts project Bitcoin could reach $225,000 by 2025, though near-term volatility remains, with prices influenced by U.S. regulatory developments and Trump's policies. Ethereum gained 0.8% to $3,669.04, XRP rose 0.3%, while Solana and Dogecoin declined.

A higher-than-expected inflation reading may reinforce the Fed’s hawkish stance, pressuring Bitcoin. Altcoins saw mixed performance: Ethereum fell 2%, XRP gained 0.7%, Solana edged up 0.8%, Polygon rose 1%, and Dogecoin jumped 4%. Market sentiment remains cautious.

Bitcoin rose 3.6% to $79.6K, rebounding from a 5-month low as traders bought the dip despite fragile sentiment from Trump’s looming tariffs. Altcoins followed, with Ether, XRP, Solana, and Dogecoin all gaining after recent steep losses.
